non_blocking_findings: Executor's AC wording for the dark-row check relies on the flow never pinning; pinned_ids.is_empty() in that check is therefore a no-op guard (AC9f confirms: dropping the product pin filter leaves the free-nav run green). The pin edge is covered only by the ssi test, which is the documented design.

Deferred follow-ups (d), (e), (f) were not independently re-measured; (e) rests on a 0.55 m BVH clearance probe (V16) that I did not rerun. The reasoning (ci-fast would need to load the ship demo for the first time, manifest-only proxy sees only the 0.75 m face rectangle) is consistent with the code (FACE_M, manifest fields) and justifies deferral as a new kind of ci-fast step, not test hygiene.
Run times are 100-175 s per short copy and 357 s for the full target; within budgets.
